state.intent: Visual morning market consensus, coffee-time glance then inspect any source. User explicitly rejects prose-first research desk. All requested sources, daily/weekly/monthly/history/evaluation.

originalReference.warning: Historical conviction percentages have not been validated; do not copy numbers or claim profit probability.

state.stack: Next.js16 React19 TypeScript, CSS tokens, lucide icons, SVG charts. Existing saved publications and hosted TradingView widgets.
catalog: consensus dial with centered lean and adjacent data-coverage bar
constraints: All visuals must use real source-backed state or explicit unavailable states.
No guarantee of profitable trading; agreement is separate from predictive confidence.
Default morning dashboard is visual. No chatbot or full-width prose lead.
Every data source remains independently inspectable.

hierarchy.instructions: Select the overall morning information hierarchy that best satisfies the explicit intent and constraints.

criteria.consensus_then_drivers: Top consensus dial, coverage and catalyst rail; independent family contribution bars below; signal grid and levels follow.
criteria.world_then_consensus: World/FX/bond overview first, then consensus and signals.
criteria.signal_matrix_first: A large signal matrix first, consensus in a right rail; drill down from matrix.

hero_visual.instructions: Select a primary visual for combined direction, keeping coverage and probability clearly separate.

criteria.semicircle_and_balance: Semicircle direction dial from bearish to bullish, textual lean, separate agreement/coverage labels and supporting/opposing bars.
criteria.diverging_stack: Large horizontal opposing-supporting bar, explicit mixed/abstain label, separate coverage.
criteria.radar: Radar of independent family scores, combined lean in center, separate coverage.

source_inspection.instructions: Select how a reader should inspect a signal, its dated raw values, formula, exclusions and primary links without losing morning context.

criteria.side_drawer: Accessible modal side drawer on desktop and full-width sheet on mobile.
criteria.inline_expand: Each signal card expands inline in the grid.
criteria.separate_page: Separate detailed source page with back navigation.

density.instructions: Select the signal grid density; readable scan speed is more important than maximizing tile count.

criteria.four_two_one: Four columns on wide desktop, two on medium, one on narrow mobile; main charts stay larger.
criteria.three_two_one: Three desktop columns, two tablet, one mobile, larger source cards.
criteria.six_three_two: Six desktop columns, three tablet and two phone compact cells.
